units.source_text: 等我醒来的时候，那个传穿藏青色短上衣的匪徒已经消失了。

en.t: When I woke up, the bandit in the dark blue short jacket had already disappeared.

units.source_text: 只有我的丈夫扔在被捆在杉树脚下。

en.t: Only my husband was left there, bound at the foot of the cedar tree.

units.source_text: 我艰难起身，看了看丈夫的脸色。

en.t: I struggled to get up and looked at my husband's face.

units.source_text: 但是丈夫的眼神和刚才一样，充满了冰冷的蔑视。

en.t: But my husband's eyes were just as before, filled with cold contempt.

units.source_text: 羞愧，耻辱，悲哀，愤怒——我内心五味杂陈。

en.t: Shame, humiliation, sorrow, anger--my heart was filled with a turmoil of feelings.

units.source_text: 我踉跄的站起来，走到丈夫身边。

en.t: I staggered to my feet and went over to my husband's side.
